nodes.description: Public address of the contract owner, set to msg.sender in the constructor and used as the access-control authority.
Public uint tracking the last completed migration index; written by setCompleted and forwarded by upgrade.
Constructor of Migrations; assigns owner = msg.sender.
External function restricted by the restricted modifier; writes last_completed_migration = completed.
External function restricted by the restricted modifier; casts newAddress to Migrations and calls setCompleted on it.
Modifier that requires msg.sender == owner before executing the modified function body.
Caller-supplied address (msg.sender) used both as the owner initialiser and as the access-control check in the restricted modifier.
External call upgraded.setCompleted(last_completed_migration) made on an address supplied via the newAddress parameter.
Parameter 'completed' of setCompleted; value flowed into last_completed_migration.
Parameter 'newAddress' of upgrade; address cast into the local Migrations variable.
Local variable 'upgraded' (Migrations instance) created from newAddress and used as the target of the external call.

edges.reason: owner state variable is assigned directly from the untrusted msg.sender in the constructor.
The restricted modifier branches on require(msg.sender == owner), making the untrusted caller the gate for all restricted functions.
The restricted modifier guards execution of setCompleted, so its access-control decision controls that function body.
The restricted modifier guards execution of upgrade, so its access-control decision controls that function body.
The 'completed' parameter value is written into the last_completed_migration state variable.
The stored last_completed_migration value is passed as the argument to the external setCompleted call.
The 'newAddress' parameter is cast into the local Migrations variable 'upgraded'.
The local 'upgraded' instance is the receiver/target of the external setCompleted call.
The upgrade function body executes the external call to upgraded.setCompleted.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter 'completed' is only meaningful as the input to setCompleted and should be folded into that core function node.
The parameter 'newAddress' exists solely to drive the upgrade function and should be merged into it.
The local Migrations variable 'upgraded' is only an intermediate handle for the external call and should be merged into that unsafe_operation node.
